; AppLoad takes keyboard focus away when it hides a window (minimize, or while
; dragging) and doesn't give it back, so keys stop reaching the app.
AFFECT /appload/qml/window.qml
TRAVERSE FocusScope
LOCATE AFTER ALL
INSERT {
    Connections {
        target: mainWindowView
        function onVisibleChanged() {
            if(mainWindowView.visible && qtfbKey != -1) windowCanvas.forceActiveFocus();
        }
    }
}
END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
